basics.name: Ella Self
basics.label: Senior
basics.summary: I am currently an undergraduate student at the University of Hawai‘i at Mānoa, pursuing my Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. I  have earned my degree AS in Spring of 2025 and expect to receive my degree BS in fall of 2027.

highlights: My job is to assist in data visualization and analysis of UH Mānoa’s power grid.I am tasked with collecting data and providing information on where to best allocate our resources for energyefficiency. As well as help develop packages to lobby for renewable energy projects across UH campuses.

To maintain our business’ five star rating, I perform the highest degree of service for our clientele. Surfing is a dangerous sport and the open ocean is unpredictable. My work requires taking decisive action to ensure optimal safety and experience for my students. In addition to this, I provide constructive feedback and motivation to push through adversity. My standard of work has honed my ability to use quick thinking, a technical eye, and concise words in order to give a once in a lifetime experience.

My work at Privateer was to expand and improve upon Playwright end-to-end (E2E) test suites to increase the reliability of Privateer's applications, optimize continuous integration (CI) pipelines, and validate user interface functionality of their platform Elements.

My work at CIRP lab is to train AI models to identify both plants and invasive species. We implement drones and robots to selectively spray invasive species to help aid in restoration and preservation of Hawaiian endemic foliage. As well as aid local businesses in agriculture efficiency and inform them how to best direct their labor force.
